notes.title: HEAR YE, HEAR YE, GLORIOUS VIKINGS!
notes.notes:
The time has come! We’re proud to finally present Version 1.0 of Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy. Our journey hasn’t always been as smooth as a freshly sharpened Viking sword, but now it’s time to close this chapter with honor and open a new one. We’re brimming with excitement about what the future holds and can’t wait to share it all with you!

[b]Valhalla Calls—and It’s Hungry![/b]
NORDIC REFINEMENT
For months, we’ve been tirelessly working in the mighty forges of Muspelheim. Your feedback was our most precious resource! The result is an epic culinary adventure that would make even Odin cheer.

[b]NEW VIGOR & STRONGER BITE[/b]
Look forward to more engaging gameplay, refined recipes, and that wild Nordic spirit carrying you straight into the depths of Helheim!

[b]CULINARY RAIDS[/b]
Band together with your shield-maidens and warrior friends to combat chaos and ruin in the kitchen. Coordinate your cooking prowess, stir the cauldrons, down the mead, and prove who’s truly ready to fry for glory!

[b]THANKS TO OUR COMMUNITY[/b]
Our deepest gratitude goes out to everyone who accompanied us through Early Access. Without your ideas, suggestions, and unwavering Viking spirit, Feast Frenzy would never have reached this point.

[b]To Battle![/b]
Version 1.0 isn’t just any update—it’s a war cry against all bland meals out there:

[list]
[*] Master the art of blazing cauldron battles
[*] Raise your horns of mead and rally with thunderous war cries
[/list]

So ready your helmets, sharpen your knives, and set forth to feed the gods!

Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy – Valhalla beckons, and your ladles await.
Gird your stomachs, let chaos reign, and celebrate the mightiest feast of your life!

notes.title: Patch Notes – Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Multiplayer Bug Fixes for a Smoother Festivity![/b][/h1]

Our Viking chefs have tackled the last multiplayer issues so you can focus on cooking and celebrating without any technical interruptions.

[b]Was wurde verbessert?[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Clients can now initiate dialogues seamlessly:[/b]
We fixed an issue where clients were unable to start dialogues with NPCs. You can now interact with NPCs during your multiplayer adventures without a hitch and enjoy your culinary journey to the fullest.
Ein Problem wurde behoben, bei dem der Client keine Dialoge mit NPCs starten konnte. Jetzt könnt ihr in den Multiplayer-Schlachten problemlos mit den Wikingern interagieren und eure kulinarischen Abenteuer genießen.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Interactions are now player-specific:[/b]
The bug where the interaction key triggered actions for both players simultaneously has been resolved. From now on, you’ll only see your own tooltips, and your interactions won’t interfere with other players. No more overlaps – each Viking can now focus on their own tools and tasks!
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and support! We hope you continue to enjoy the feasts and fun in
[i]Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy![/i]

notes.title: God’s Drink & Master Chef Update
notes.notes:
[i][u][b]New Features[/b][/u][/i]

[b]God’s Drink[/b]
After much anticipation, especially following its preview at Gamescom, we’re thrilled to introduce the God’s Drink! In each level, you can now brew this special drink, inspired by our partner Nordmet. Learn the art of brewing by speaking with select animals who will reveal its secrets. Deliver the drink and earn double Odin’s coins!
For those who attended Gamescom and had a taste of Nordmet’s brew: now you can experience it in the game!

[b]Pinning Recipes[/b]
We’ve added a new feature to help you stay organized! Now, you can pin essential recipes directly to your interface by using the alternate interaction with runes, giving you a clear view of your current tasks at any time.

[b]Odin’s Coins on the Altar[/b]
The altar now shows the total number of Odin’s coins you’ve collected, making it easier to track your progress. Save up and see your achievements at a glance.

[i][u][b]Optimizations[/b][/u][/i]

[b]Font Updates[/b]
To enhance readability in certain parts of the game, we’ve replaced the rune font with a standardized one.

[b]Improved Post-Processing Effects[/b]
We’ve refined the post-processing effects across various scenarios for an even more immersive visual experience!

[b]Smooth Rune Fading[/b]
Now, recipe runes will fade out gently when you successfully complete a recipe, creating a smoother gameplay experience.

[b]New Viking Chef Logo[/b]
Enjoy a fresh, updated logo for Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy, modernizing our branding and giving the game a visual boost!

notes.title: New Update 0.6.0 for Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy – Rediscover Your Culinary Advent
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[b]Exciting news:[/b] The Early Access Update [b]0.6.0 for Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy[/b] is finally here! This version focuses on altering the gameplay experience to make it more immersive overall. We’re eager to hear your feedback on these changes. Here are the highlights:

[list]
[*] [b]Ingame UI Revamp:[/b] We've removed the menu display from the left side of the screen. In its place, you'll find a rune stone where small runes represent the dishes you need to cook. Interact with these runes to see their corresponding recipes.
[*] [b]UI Improvements:[/b] The user interface has been overhauled to look as if it's been carved in stone – literally!
[*] [b]New Tutorial:[/b] Start your adventure directly in the forest, where you'll prepare your first salad. The tutorial has been refreshed with new camera movements to enhance your experience.
[*] [b]Changed Interaction Mechanism:[/b] The way you target objects for interaction has been updated. Instead of automatic selection based on your character's position, you now need to look at the object with the camera.
[*] [b]A Fresh Recipe Book:[/b] Discover the culinary delights with our new recipe book!
[/list]

For the next update, our main focus will be on polishing the game to prepare it for its full release. We aim to refine the UI and gameplay flow, along with implementing small yet impactful effects to round out the experience.

We hope you enjoy version 0.6.0 and look forward to your feedback. Let the Viking feasts begin!

Your Devlex

notes.title: Dev Update #4: An Honest Update
notes.notes:
Hey friends,

It's been a while since our last developer update. The end of 2023 and January have given me a lot of time for self-reflection, especially since I had to deal more intensively with my thoughts due to my family's situation.

Feast Frenzy is currently in a difficult phase. The joy of developing has somewhat diminished, due to the lack of success and the feeling of not learning anything new. I was even on the verge of throwing everything away and starting from scratch. But after many sleepless nights, I've realized that's not the solution. I must accept the decisions made and move on.

I don't want to be the reason why Early Access has a bad reputation. Therefore, I've decided to finish the game - with discipline, even without the initial enthusiasm. Having a completed game, even if it doesn't achieve the expected success, makes me a true game developer.

As described in the last update, I will shorten the roadmap and adjust the scope of the game, but to compensate, I will also adjust the price. Those who wish to support the game can buy it at the current price, or wait for the new, lower price.

Thank you to everyone who has taken the time to read this far. Your support and feedback are immensely valuable to me.

Your Devlex

notes.title: Dev Update #3: The Roadmap will be changed
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

As I mentioned in the last Dev Update, I've decided to make some significant changes to the roadmap.

To be honest, Feast Frenzy hasn't evolved into the game (in terms of gameplay) that I originally had in mind, and because of this, I feel a certain disconnect with the game.

However, instead of just burying the project, I want to lead it to a decent release. Therefore, the content for the release will be altered as follows:

[list]
[*] We will stick to the three levels we have so far.
[*] The focus will mainly be on optimizing the gameplay of these levels.
[*] Additionally, I want to optimize the game's performance to support older or less powerful systems.
[*] As compensation for Early Access buyers, there will be a special accessory available only during Early Access, which will be the axe from the cover art. These axe will come with an later update.
[*] The focus of Early Access will also continue to be on UI improvements and game polishing.
[/list]

I would like to take this opportunity to thank all the Early Access participants for their support.
Now, I wish you all a wonderful Christmas season and a happy transition into the new year.

The next Dev Update will follow in 2024!

Your Devlex

notes.title: Dev Update #2: Reflection of the past

In the last weeks I did many many retrospectives over the past development timeline. And did some decisions, how it will be go on with feast frenzy.
The complete details I can’t tell you know, that’s something I must prepare for my self first. But one thing I can tell, the game will not be finished this year and also the content for the full release will not that one, that I imagined as I‘m gone into early access.
I need to take some economical and realistic decisions for the future development plans.

notes.title: Next update is coming by the end of the week
notes.notes:
Hey there,

As I approached the ancient Seidr, the mystic air around us became thick with anticipation. With a deep, otherworldly gaze, the Seidr leaned in and shared the revelations of the gods regarding the future of "Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy".

"The gods have spoken to me," he began with a voice echoing the winds of time, "and they see a world where the tales of 'Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy' will be shared in tongues many and varied. Soon, voices from the lands of the English, the Deutsch, and the Español, and perhaps even beyond, will echo in harmony."

The Seidr paused, taking a deep breath as if drawing energy from the cosmos itself. "Moreover, the All-Father and his pantheon desire for mortals to have more control over the visual realms they traverse. Soon, a grander portal of choices will unveil, allowing one to mold the very essence of sight within the game."

He then cast his eyes downward, deep in thought. "The gods also recognize the struggles of some mortals. They have decreed further enhancements, making the journey within 'Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy' even more accessible to all who wish to embark."

With that, the Seidr slowly retreated, leaving behind an air of mystery and excitement about what's to come for "Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy".

notes.notes:
Hello Warriors of the Culinary North!

I'm excited to bring you the latest Alpha Update. While a substantial portion of my recent efforts went into backend preparations – especially gearing up for marketing and playtest launches – there are notable changes in this iteration that will enhance your gaming experience.

Also, a quick note: Alpha 4 is set to be my final "internal alpha" before I roll into playtesting. The grand playtest will kick off with Alpha 5. Due to some health challenges I faced last week, there's a possibility that the playtest might shift to the next week. I'm putting in my utmost effort to get it out by the end of this week, but I can't set it in stone just yet. Your patience and understanding are greatly appreciated.

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Introducing an early version of a holding item animation for the player.
[*] A new 'hurry up' indication featuring a jingle and a flashing clock.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced controller support.
[*] Resolved various UI glitches.
[*] Fixed a bug that reset the player's look rotation.
[*] Redesigned the rewards UI a little bit for a more engaging look.
[*] Temporarily disabled the detailed workstep view in the recipe book. Keep an eye out – a more intuitive system is in the works and will be seamlessly integrated into the gameplay in our upcoming update.
[/list]

Thank you for joining me on this grand adventure. Your feedback and support continue to drive me forward!

notes.title: Register for the public playtest
notes.notes:
Hey Chefs!

If you visit the store page of Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy you have noch the possibility to register for the public playtest, which will start hopefully at the end of the next week.
Don't miss your opportunity to get a first look into Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy and tell me your impression of the game!

See you soon in Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy

notes.title: Alpha 3 - Update
notes.notes:
Hey there,

today there comes a small update, but with a big change!
If you start the game, you have only 1 recipe in your book. To unlock new recipes, you need to deliver all dishes in a game round.

Just a little disclaimer, the UI of the new features is a first "sketch".

[b]Patchnotes:[/b]
[b]New Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Introducing the recipe unlock system:
[list]
[*] Choose between 3 random recipes as a reward for successfully finishing a game.
[*]  You start with 1 known recipe in your book (for initial testing purposes only).
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] On multiple outputs at the cooking station, only the first one receives a quality multiplier.
[*] In multiplayer games, with more players than just yourself, the game no longer pauses when you open the pause menu.
[*] Recipes were respawned when you reached the "hurry up" phase.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 2 - Update
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

Over three weeks ago, I started the first alpha test! It was amazing, but that was only the beginning. I've hustled much and can now present you the first patch notes for the game, to introduce the Alpha2!

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new recipes:
[list]
[*] Norse Stockfish
[*] Poached fish
[*] Cheese Salad
[/list]
[*] Number of recipes you need to cook are now increased to 7.
[*] Time is set to 5 minutes for better testing.
[*] Introduced level music and win/lose jingles.
[*] Introduced main menu music.
[*] Introduced splashscreen.
[*] Options screen now available from the main menu.
[*] RecipeBook with Workstep Details is now accessible in main menu and pause screen.
[*] Quality system has been introduced, along with quality times for recipes.
[*] Introduced win screen which calculates score based on quality and needed time to finish.
[*] Introduced a new ktichenobject: The smashcounter to beat your stockfish
[*] Multi-output capability has been added for the cooking counter.
[*] Multi-input capability has been added for the cooking counter.
[*] Containers can now hold multiple items.
[*] Containers now have an limited stock of items.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the host was able to kick themselves.
[*] Building boundaries added to prevent unwanted glitching.
[*] Reduced the intensity of the glow effect.
[*] Camera shake in the main menu has been toned down.
[*] Fixed a bug where clients did not receive recipes at game start.
[*] Planted some trees and reordered the kitchen.
[*] Removed burger recipes.
[/list]
